site_note: V2 item 5.3 (two primaries): only on a Case File linked to the same patient's other Case File, and only for histopathology, cytology, IHC and molecular records: among several candidates for one record, or several documents carrying a required value, one that names another protocol's site and not this one steps aside and is named on the row for review; a document naming no site never does, and when every candidate names another site every candidate stays. Organ words only. A preference, never a filter; a patient with one cancer is checked as before.
note: DRAFT, not approved for real use: needs a clinician's check. Configurable by the clinical team. Required records transcribed from the NCG Guidelines for Pediatric Haematolymphoid and Solid Tumours (2019) (National Cancer Grid, India), the Wilms tumour pages (algorithm p 44, chemotherapy and SIOP note p 45, staging p 46, Annexure 1 p 64; PDF pages, the printed footer is one less), each with its verbatim quote and page. Tiers printed by NCG are kept; the tiers whose tier_basis says 'proposed' are proposals, to be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use). A record NCG gives only under a condition the system never judges (a finding, a plan) is shown with NCG's own tier and the condition, never counted. The stage and the risk group are as recorded by the clinician, never computed. Nothing here suggests treatment. The book lists no baseline blood tests for Wilms tumour, only imaging and tissue, so none is listed. The CT scan for reassessment after chemotherapy is a follow-up step and is not listed. The paediatric renal tumour pathology proforma named in the book's contents is not in the file. Adult kidney cancer is a separate checklist (kidney).
settings_note: Setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes stage and never decides the setting). The two settings follow the book's algorithm (p 44): 'Unilateral Renal Mass' and 'Bilateral Renal Mass'. Each record carries its tier per setting; until a setting is recorded the strictest tier applies. Draft checklist: needs a clinician's check.
